newsitem.title: USA: Collins sets warrant expiration extension.
newsitem.headline: Collins sets warrant expiration extension.

text.p: Collins Industries Inc said Monday it set a final extension for the expiration of its outstanding warrants.

The company said the warrants, which were originally scheduled to expire February 28, will now have an expiration date of February 28, 1998. As of January 1, there were 479,999 warrants outstanding, Collins said.
Each warrant may be exercised to purchase 1.25 Collins Industries common shares, the company said. The exercise price of $9.75 remains unchanged, Collins said.
Collins makes ambulances, buses and trucks. Its shares closed up 1/8 Monday at five.
